name: IC Driver Display — 3V — WSON
description: Surface-mount 3V display driver IC cluster featuring WSON packages such as WSON-6-1EP (2x2mm, 0.65mm pitch).
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 3V display driver IC in an SMD WSON package.
Verify pad layout matches WSON-6-1EP 2x2mm with 0.65mm pitch and 1x1.6mm exposed pad.
Prefer tier A verified parts such as TPS61165DRV.
avoid_when: Through-hole or non-WSON package mounting is required.
The application requires operating parameters other than 3V display driver specs.
The PCB design cannot accept a WSON-6-1EP footprint.
